decision: Excluded from the selected three-component core build and retained under research: C-language interface wrapper is not a selected core module.
evidence: The module declares itself a C to PARSER interface and exports _parse.
The three selected reference-build object lists omit _parse.obj.
No other selected core source or include references _parse.asm or _parse; COMMAND uses tparse.asm and the shared parse.asm instead.
limitations: Exclusion applies to the selected three-component build; this does not establish that the wrapper was absent from other DOS 6.20 products.
